_comment: Copy to <project>/.claude/audit-checks.json and edit. Every check encodes ONE project rule (link it in 'why'); every exemption records the decision behind it in 'decided'. Delete checks for rules your project does not have. Patterns below assume a layered web backend (routes -> services -> repositories) in Python; adapt names and globs to your stack.

checks.title: hardcoded localhost in application code
checks.decided: config defaults are allowed (they are overridden per environment)

checks.title: SQL built with f-strings
checks.why: interpolated SQL is injectable unless every value is an internal literal or escaped — read each hit

checks.title: filesystem path built from a request-supplied id
checks.why: reject '..', absolute paths and NUL in ONE path builder before joining

checks.title: security enforcement switch with a permissive default
checks.why: a fix that defaults to log-only is inert wherever no environment overrides it — check every deploy overlay

checks.title: optional tenant scope parameter
checks.why: a caller can silently omit the scope and read across tenants — flag even when a scoped branch exists

checks.title: tenant scope taken from the request instead of the session
checks.why: the scope must come from the authenticated session; a parameter lets callers choose any tenant

checks.title: router without auth dependencies (verify per-endpoint auth)
checks.why: protection exists only where declared — read each router's endpoints for an auth dependency

checks.title: route touches the database directly
checks.why: routes call services; the session is usually named db in route signatures — match both names

checks.title: route imports a repository
checks.why: the root cause of C2: a route holding a repository has to own the transaction

checks.title: session/permission extraction outside the auth helpers
checks.why: one helper reads permissions; copies drift

checks.title: broad exception swallowed
checks.why: silent failure hides bugs; log, narrow, or re-raise with the cause

checks.title: date formatting in templates instead of the shared filter
checks.why: dates follow user preferences through one filter
checks.decided: exempt form inputs that require ISO values

checks.title: singular module file names where the convention is plural
checks.why: convention: *_models.py, *_schemas.py (the hit is the file itself)
